import ast,hashlib,importlib.util,io,pathlib,unittest
root=pathlib.Path(r'D:\MyRepository\Blender-addons-by-Randy')
p=root/'tests/test_animation_rigging_recovery.py'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('order_regression',p);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
original=m.functions
def old_order(path,names,namespace):
    original(path,names,namespace)
    if '_apply' not in names:return
    tree=ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    fn=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='_apply')
    for node in ast.walk(fn):
        if isinstance(node,ast.For):
            target=next((n for n in node.body if isinstance(n,ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func,ast.Name) and n.value.func.id=='_write_target'),None)
            hint=next((n for n in node.body if isinstance(n,ast.If) and isinstance(n.test,ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.test.slice,ast.Constant) and n.test.slice.value=='hintWeight'),None)
            if target is not None and hint is not None:
                node.body.remove(target);node.body.insert(node.body.index(hint),target)
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fn],type_ignores=[]),str(path),'exec'),namespace)
m.functions=old_order
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(unittest.TestSuite([m.PreviewWeightSemanticsTests('test_apply_auto_align_readback_uses_final_pole_and_settled_right_parent')]))
assert len(result.failures)==2 and not result.errors,(result.failures,result.errors)
